'''Thoran''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==History==
This planet was colonized by [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]].<ref name="TF" />
